name: Storage triage and conservative maintenance
packageArguments: Optional string values, encoded as base64 JSON: {"Mode":"Report","TempAgeDays":"7","ProfileAgeDays":"60","RemoveProfiles":"false","ExcludeProfiles":"","ComponentCleanup":"false","MaxFiles":"20000","MaxSeconds":"30"}. Mode Report or Cleanup; TempAgeDays 1-365; ProfileAgeDays 30-3650; exclusions comma-separated exact SID or full profile path. Profile removal and supported component cleanup require separate explicit true flags and clear servicing guards. Profile removal uses Win32_UserProfile with fresh identity/session/hive/activity checks; only coherent old ProfileList load/unload pairs qualify. CIM/file-only age never authorizes deletion. Recent CIM conflicts and incomplete collection require review. Recent NTUSER alone can be a servicing touch. Security4624 interactive events only add a keep veto; absent/rotated logs never prove inactivity. MaxFiles 1-2000000, MaxSeconds 1-1800; deeper scans require explicit budgets. File/time bounds apply to scans and cleanup, DISM separately waits up to five minutes and may continue if timed out. Full JSON persists under ProgramData/Relian/StorageMaintenance with a compact stdout JSON summary; no custom fields or device API. Reports logical bytes and actual free-space delta; cache, rollback, installer and user-data opportunities are report-only. Report can initialize PSADT progress for an active user. Stdout includes bounded before/after free bytes, top consumers, age-qualified temp opportunities and profile decision counts with explicit truncation; Setup light reports retain volume snapshots. Native DISM stdout/stderr use child-owned file handles independent of the launcher lifetime.
